## Summary
The MCP blue-green autodeploy emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {reason: deploy_failed}` (→ `rebar/host:deploy_errors`, which pages the `rebar-autodeploy-errors` alarm) on TWO conditions that are *documented as routine, non-error backoffs that must be kept OUT of deploy_errors*: `port-exhausted` (retire-cap) and low-memory abort. This false-pages the general "deploys are failing" alarm during a normal landing burst, when the deploy is in fact correctly, safely deferring.

## Evidence (live, 2026-08-30 ~03:33–04:05 UTC on i-00880b2c7f13527c5)
During a burst of merges, both blue/green MCP ports (8092/8093) were held by un-reaped containers still in their 21-min graceful drain (`docker stop --time 1260`). Each deploy tick logged BOTH markers for the same event:
```
AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP {reason: port-exhausted, ...}
AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {reason: deploy_failed, detail: component=mcp target=... fail#1..4 backoff=60s..480s}
```
`rebar-autodeploy-errors` (deploy_errors, Sum>0 / 4 periods) and `rebar-autodeploy-mcp-retire-cap` BOTH went ALARM. It self-resolved (~04:15). No outage — MCP served the old build throughout; only the cutover was delayed.

## Root cause
`infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`: `record_mcp_backoff_failure` (~L668) calls `err deploy_failed "component=mcp ..."` → emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` → inflates `deploy_errors`. It is invoked on the two routine backoff paths — low-mem abort (~L915, after `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT`) and port-exhausted (~L924, after `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP`). This contradicts the documented contract in `infra/scripts/observability.sh` (~L284-291, L355): the retire-cap and mem-abort markers are "each kept out of AUTODEPLOY_ERROR so a routine retire-cap / memory abort never inflates deploy_errors." The sustained case is already covered by the dedicated `mcp_retire_cap` / `mcp_mem_abort` alarms. Introduced by the blue-green commit `2a0a4b19f2ab` (ticket 6964), which shipped both the contract and the violating code — an internally-inconsistent plan (`plan_defect`).

## Standing intent — this is a fix, not a behavior decision
The intended behavior is documented in observability.sh. The code simply doesn't match it. No ADR / design decision required.

## Fix
Factor the backoff-timer bookkeeping (write `$MCP_BACKOFF_FILE` + prune) out of the `err deploy_failed` emission via a shared `schedule_mcp_backoff` helper. Add a `record_mcp_routine_backoff` variant (schedule + log, no `err deploy_failed`) and switch the two routine paths to it. Genuine-failure paths (build/tag/run/unhealthy/handshake/flip) keep `record_mcp_backoff_failure` and still page. The throttle still applies on all paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A routine `port-exhausted` (retire-cap) backoff does NOT emit `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR/deploy_failed` and does NOT increment `deploy_errors`; the `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP` marker + `mcp_retire_cap` metric remain the signal.
- [x] A routine low-memory abort likewise does NOT inflate `deploy_errors`; `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT` + `mcp_mem_abort` remain the signal.
- [x] GENUINE MCP deploy failures (build-failed, tag-failed, run-failed, unhealthy, handshake, flip) STILL emit `deploy_failed` and page `deploy_errors` (no regression to real-failure alarming).
- [x] The mcp backoff throttle (timer/prune) still applies on the routine paths so ticks don't hammer during a drain — only the erroneous deploy_errors emission is removed (the `mcp-deploy-backoff` file is still written).
- [x] A regression test asserts the observable outcome: the retire-cap/mem-abort paths emit their own marker but NOT `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`, while a real failure emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`.

## Testing
- `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py` — includes new `test_port_exhausted_routine_backoff_does_not_inflate_deploy_errors` and `test_low_memory_routine_backoff_does_not_inflate_deploy_errors` (assert routine marker present, no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR/deploy_failed`, throttle file still written), plus existing `test_mcp_failure_keeps_the_deploy_failed_metric_and_names_the_component` and `test_unhealthy_new_container_leaves_old_upstream_current` (genuine failures still emit `deploy_failed`).
- Verified: `make lint` (shellcheck), `make typecheck`, `make test` all green. Mutation check: reintroducing `record_mcp_backoff_failure` on the routine sites returns both new tests to RED.

## Notes
Checked for duplication against the blue-green target ticket (6964) and the graceful-drain-contract bug (b580) — not duplicates. The plan-review overlap detector flags shared artifact `record_mcp_backoff_failure` with e1d9 (handshake gate, already landed in origin/main) and the held-back sibling `prespinal-gem-kinkajou` (dbf0); this change edits disjoint lines (function def + the two routine call sites) and lands first in the autodeploy.sh cluster.
